title: Workspaces
intro: raven.workspaces controls panel visibility hints. It does not change the ten-workspace count.

blocks.label: Workspace options
rows: "occupied" shows occupied, active, and persistent workspaces. "all" shows all ten.
Workspace numbers from 1 to 10 that remain visible when empty.

blocks.text: Use the ext/workspaces module with ignore-hidden set to true. With false, Waybar shows all ten regardless of Raven’s hints. Raven does not edit the Waybar configuration.
